name: Auto-Backup Host Validation Exerciser
description: Task-local exerciser for the native auto-backup manager takeover (settings, backupNow, WebDAV sync).

permissions.reason: Reads the active modeling document and parameter state to gate the exerciser.
Dirtys the copied fixture through ModelTransaction + WriteParameterCommand to drive a native backup.
The per-plugin auto-backup coordinator publishes BackupCompletedEvent on this plugin's event bus.
